mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`media_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_collectible v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_collectible sv ON v.id = sv.collectible_id WHERE v.media_id = #{mediaId} AND v.status = 1

SELECT v.`id`, v.`media_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock`, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time, m.`name` AS media_name FROM tb_collectible v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_collectible sv ON v.id = sv.collectible_id LEFT JOIN tb_media m ON v.media_id = m.id WHERE v.type = 1 AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY sv.begin_time DESC
